{{Top|leg}}
'''MaxSec Orbital Facility''' was a term used to identify a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] considered a maximum-security [[Prison/Legends|prison]]. These stations held incarcerated [[Prisoner/Legends|criminals]] without burdening [[Planet/Legends|planet]]-side facilities.
